mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_setting (setting_key, value, updated_by, updated_by_name, updated_at) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedByName}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (setting_key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_by_name = EXCLUDED.updated_by_name, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
